REGENT OF BANGLI
PROVINCE OF BALI
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANGLI REGENCY
NUMBER 18 YEAR 2016
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY
REGENT OF BANGLI,

Considering : that with the enactment of Law Number 23 Year 2002 concerning Child Protection as amended by Law Number 35 Year 2014 Concerning Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2002 Concerning Child Protection and Law Number 24 Year 2004 concerning Elimination of Domestic Violence, it is deemed necessary to prevent and overcome violence against Women and Children through legal protection for Women and Children victims of violence;
that based on the consideration as referred to in letter a, mentioned above, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence;

In View of :

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: Region is Bangli Regency.
Regional Government is the Government of Bangli Regency.
Bupati is the Bupati of Bangli.
Regional House of Representatives hereinafter referred to as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bangli Regency.
Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
Woman is an adult human of female gender and a person recognized by law as a Woman.
Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including a Child in the womb.
Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including neglect, threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.
Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child committed by parties who should be responsible for the Child or those who have power over the Child.
Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.
Victim is a Woman and Child who experiences misery and/or suffering as a result of violence and/or threat of violence.
Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction to be able to carry out social functions properly.
Repatriation is an effort to return victims of Violence from the Regional territory to the region of origin.
Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims Legal Aid is legal services provided by companions, law enforcement officers which include providing legal consultation, exercising power of attorney, representing, accompanying, defending and taking other legal actions for victims of violence.
Integrated Service Center hereinafter referred to as PPT is a functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of acts of violence.
Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) is an integrated service unit established by the Regency government to provide services to Women and Children victims of violence comprehensively including complaint services, health rehabilitation; social rehabilitation; repatriation; social reintegration, and legal aid.
Minimum Service Standards hereinafter referred to as SPM is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing services for handling reports/complaints, health services, social rehabilitation, enforcement and legal aid, as well as repatriation and social reintegration for Women and Children victims of violence.
Desa Pakraman is a customary law community unit in Bali Province that has a unified tradition and etiquette of social life of the Hindu community passed down through generations in the bond of Kahyangan Tiga or Kahyangan Desa which has a specific territory and its own assets and has the right to manage its own household;
Social Protection House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

NUMBER 18 OF 2016
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
GENERAL
Violence against Women and Children is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known that the human rights of Women and Children have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore the protection of the rights of Women and Children from violence should be respected, upheld and enhanced in human dignity without discrimination, welfare and justice for Women and Children.
Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children victims of violence have not received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women and Children in Bangli Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children victims of violence in Bangli Regency.

Article 15
Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of Women and Children shall be conducted at the end of each fiscal year or when necessary according to needs.
The results of the evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of Women and Children shall be used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of Women and Children for the following year.
The evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

CHAPTER VII
SOCIAL PROTECTION HOUSE
Article 12
Regional Government is obligated to establish a Social Protection House and/or Safe House.
The Social Protection House and/or Safe House as referred to in paragraph (1) guarantees the implementation of health rehabilitation services, social rehabilitation, repatriation, and social reintegration.
In the event that a victim experiences trauma or illness that endangers themselves as a result of acts of violence requiring immediate assistance, the Regional Government is obligated to provide first aid no later than 7 (seven) days after the complaint is filed.
For the implementation of services as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Government may utilize social protection houses and/or Safe Houses owned by the community or other social service institutions.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children victims of violence have not received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women and Children in Bangli Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children victims of violence in Bangli Regency.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Social Protection House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children victims of violence have not received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women and Children in Bangli Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children victims of violence in Bangli Regency.

CHAPTER VIII
MONITORING AND EVALUATION
Article 13
The Regional Government conducts monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity, and effectiveness of integrated measures in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.
The monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence in the Region.

CHAPTER XII
FUNDING
Article 20
Funds for the implementation of protection for Women and Children Victims of violence, are sourced from: regional revenue and expenditure budget; and other legal and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: Region is Bangli Regency.
Regional Government is the Government of Bangli Regency.
Bupati is the Bupati of Bangli.
Regional House of Representatives hereinafter referred to as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bangli Regency.
Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
Woman is an adult human of female gender and a person recognized by law as a Woman.
Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including a Child in the womb.
Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including neglect, threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.
Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child committed by parties who should be responsible for the Child or those who have power over the Child.
Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.
Victim is a Woman and Child who experiences misery and/or suffering as a result of violence and/or threat of violence.
Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction to be able to carry out social functions properly.
Repatriation is an effort to return victims of Violence from the Regional territory to the region of origin.
Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims Legal Aid is legal services provided by companions, law enforcement officers which include providing legal consultation, exercising power of attorney, representing, accompanying, defending and taking other legal actions for victims of violence.
Integrated Service Center hereinafter referred to as PPT is a functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of acts of violence.
Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) is an integrated service unit established by the Regency government to provide services to Women and Children victims of violence comprehensively including complaint services, health rehabilitation; social rehabilitation; repatriation; social reintegration, and legal aid.
Minimum Service Standards hereinafter referred to as SPM is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing services for handling reports/complaints, health services, social rehabilitation, enforcement and legal aid, as well as repatriation and social reintegration for Women and Children victims of violence.
Desa Pakraman is a customary law community unit in Bali Province that has a unified tradition and etiquette of social life of the Hindu community passed down through generations in the bond of Kahyangan Tiga or Kahyangan Desa which has a specific territory and its own assets and has the right to manage its own household;
Social Protection House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Article 15
Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of Women and Children shall be conducted at the end of each fiscal year or when necessary according to needs.
The results of the evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of Women and Children shall be used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of Women and Children for the following year.
The evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
